title: National Bobblehead Hall of Fame and Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: RedLine Milwaukee, located at 1422 North 4th Street in Milwaukee, and The National Bobblehead Hall of Fame and Museum teamed up to bring Milwaukee the first glimpse of the future museum in an unforgettable exhibition: Bobbleheads: Real & Fantastical Heroism. Open from January 22nd to April 30th, 2016 this exhibition was free and open to the public. Show hours wereThursday 10am-7pm, and Fridays & Saturdays from 10am-3pm. Our public opening on January 22nd coincided with Gallery Night, which took place from 6pm-9pm.
